detail.title: Staff member
detail.notFoundBody: They may not work in this school, or the link is wrong. Go back to the list and choose them again.
detail.noAccessBody: Ask the principal or office admin to give you the permission to manage users.
detail.loadErrorBody: Check your internet connection and reload the page. If it keeps happening, contact support.

detail.invitedTitle: Waiting for them to sign in

detail.contactHidden: This person already has a SchoolOS account, so they accept or decline the invitation themselves when they sign in. Their email appears here only after they accept.
detail.removedBody: They can no longer sign in to this school. To give them access again, send a new invitation.
detail.detailsNote: Only people who can manage users (for example the principal or office admin) can change these details.

activate.body: They can sign in to this school again with the same roles and classes.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.body: They can't sign in to this school until someone gives access back. Their roles and classes are kept.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.body: They lose access to this school for good. This can't be undone; to add them again you must send a new invitation.
remove.invitedBody: The invitation is cancelled and can't be used. To add them later, send a new invitation.

detail.selfNoStatus: This is your own account, so you can't suspend or remove it here. Ask another person who manages users if that is needed.

edit.emailHint: Leave it empty to remove the email address.
edit.languageHint: The language SchoolOS uses for this person.

detail.profileShared: This person also works at another school on SchoolOS, so their name, email and language are shared and can't be changed here. Ask them to update their profile, or contact SchoolOS support.

resend.noEmail: There is no email address for this person, so the invitation can't be emailed. Add one with Edit details, or give them their sign-in ID yourself.

breakglass_membership.title: This is temporary SchoolOS support access
breakglass_membership.body: Change or end it on the Support access page.

own_account.title: You can't change your own access

profile_shared.title: This person's profile is shared with another school
profile_shared.body: They also work at another school on SchoolOS, so their name, email and language can't be changed here. Ask them to update it, or contact SchoolOS support.

duplicate.title: This person already has access
duplicate.body: Someone with this sign-in ID is already in this school's list of users. Find them in the list instead.

precondition_failed.title: Someone else changed this person first
precondition_failed.body: Reload the page to see their change, then make yours again.

roles_required.title: Choose at least one role
roles_required.body: A staff member keeps at least one role. To stop their access, use Suspend or Remove instead.

email_disabled.title: Email isn't switched on for this school
email_disabled.body: Give the person their sign-in ID yourself, or contact SchoolOS support to switch email on.

not_invited.title: This person is no longer waiting for an invitation
not_invited.body: They have already signed in, or they were removed. Reload the page to see their status.

invitation_expired.title: This invitation has expired
invitation_expired.body: Remove this person and invite them again to send a new invitation.

email_missing.title: There is no email address for this person
email_missing.body: Add their email address with Edit details, then send the invitation again.

rate_limited.title: The invitation was sent a few minutes ago

inviteForm.emailHint: Leave it empty if they have no email address.

inviteForm.languageHint: The language SchoolOS uses for this person.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: See who changed or viewed important records, and when.
audit.emptyBody: Try a wider date range or clear the filters.

integrity.title: Audit log integrity
integrity.description: Check that no audit event was changed, removed or inserted afterwards.
integrity.noAccessTitle: You can't check the audit log
integrity.noAccessBody: This check is for staff who can read the audit log, such as the principal. Ask your school's office admin if you need this.
integrity.howBody: Every audit event is linked to the one before it by a fingerprint. SchoolOS checks every fingerprint each night. "Check again" also checks the events added since the last check; you can ask once every 10 minutes.
integrity.okBody: Verified up to event {last}: {count, plural, one {# event was} other {# events were}} checked and none was changed.
integrity.okEmpty: There are no audit events to check yet.
integrity.brokenTitle: The audit log is broken at event {seq}
integrity.brokenIntact: Events before it are intact ({count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}}, up to event {last}).
integrity.brokenFromStart: The problem starts at the first event.
integrity.brokenAction: Do not try to fix this yourself. Contact SchoolOS support now and tell them the event number above.

reason.duplicate_seq: Two events have the same number.
reason.seq_gap: An event is missing: the numbers skip one.
reason.prev_hash_mismatch: This event is not linked to the event before it.
reason.hash_mismatch: This event was changed after it was recorded.
reason.head_missing: The record of the latest event is missing.
reason.head_mismatch: The latest event does not match the recorded end of the log.
reason.other: The events do not link up as expected.
reason.checkpoint_mismatch: The last verified event was changed after it was checked.

integrity.notRunBody: The first check runs tonight, or now when you select Check integrity.
integrity.queuedBody: The check is waiting to run. The result appears here in a few minutes; you can leave this page.
integrity.okIncremental: Verified up to event {last}: {count, plural, =0 {no new events since the last check} one {# new event was checked} other {# new events were checked}} and none was changed.
integrity.coolDownTitle: The log was checked a moment ago
integrity.coolDownBody: You can ask for another check in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. SchoolOS also checks the whole log every night.

audit.exportNote: The file holds the events the filters select, oldest first. You may be asked to sign in again to confirm it's you. Every download is recorded in this audit log.

too_many_events.title: Too many events for one file
too_many_events.body: Choose a shorter date range with the From and To dates, then download again.

schoolDetail.activateBody: Staff can sign in once the school is active.

schoolDetail.reactivateBody: Staff can sign in again straight away.

schoolDetail.approveOffboardBody: Staff access ends and the deletion process starts. This cannot be undone.

offboarding.auditRetained: The school's audit log is kept until {date}, then deleted.

bases.delivered_by_us: We delivered the export to the school

provision.description: Create a new school with its own encryption key, default roles, subscription and an owner invite.

fields.schoolNameHint: The name staff and parents know the school by.
fields.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example sri-saraswati. It cannot change later.
fields.boardsHint: Comma-separated codes, for example CBSE, STATE_AP.
fields.sharedHint: Runs on the shared SchoolOS platform in Mumbai. Suits most schools.
fields.dedicatedHint: One isolated server for this school, with its own storage and keys. You get a heartbeat key for the host.
fields.customDomainHint: Dedicated deployments only, for example office.school.edu.in.
fields.ownerHint: The owner gets an invite and must use two-step sign-in. Required for shared schools.
fields.ownerHintDedicated: Optional for dedicated schools: the owner can be added on the host during setup.
fields.ownerSubjectHint: The user ID created for the owner in the staff sign-in service (no spaces).
fields.planHint: Only published plans for the chosen deployment are listed.
fields.noPlans: No published plans for this deployment yet. Publish one in Plans and pricing first.
fields.priceOverrideHint: Leave empty to use the plan's price. GST is added on top.

provision.reviewIntro: Check these details before you provision the school.
provision.errorSummary: {count, plural, one {# field needs attention} other {# fields need attention}}
provision.heartbeatBody: The dedicated host uses this key to sign its heartbeats. Put it in the host's parameter store as described in the runbook.
provision.doneShared: The school, its keys, roles and subscription are ready. Make it live from its page when the owner is set up.
provision.doneDedicated: The deployment, subscription and billing account are recorded. Build the host with the runbook next.

ownerInvite.pending_role: The owner's invitation will be sent once the school is set up.
ownerInvite.not_applicable: No owner invitation: add the owner on the dedicated host.
ownerInvite.existing: The owner already has a SchoolOS account; they were added to this school.

plans.title: Plans and pricing
plans.description: Plans are versioned: a published plan never changes. Prices are in rupees; GST is added on invoices.
plans.draftNote: This saves a draft. Publish it to offer it to schools.
plans.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example standard.
plans.codeNewVersionHint: Same code: this becomes the next version.
plans.sacHint: Six digits; leave empty for the default.
plans.limitsHint: Leave empty for no limit. Limits never block school work; they trigger alerts at 80% and 100%.
plans.publishBody: Once published, its prices and limits can never change. New subscriptions can use it.
plans.retireBody: No new subscriptions can use it. Existing subscriptions continue.
plans.emptyBody: Create and publish a plan with prices and limits before provisioning schools.
plans.oneTimeFeeHint: Implementation and data verification, before GST. Charged once, on the school's first invoice. Leave empty for none.
plans.planDescriptionHint: Plain words about what the plan gives a school, up to 300 characters.
plans.bundlesBody: A monthly add-on for monthly plans. Each bundle includes a number of AI answers a month; answers above it are billed on the next invoice at the price per extra answer. Prices are before GST.
plans.bundlesEmptyBody: AI answer bundles come from the billing catalogue.
plans.editBody: Only drafts can change. Once published, a plan's prices and limits are fixed.
plans.fixedFieldsNote: The plan code, deployment, billing period, pricing, GST rate and SAC code stay as they are. To change them, save a new version instead.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Trials, active and past-due subscriptions. Plan changes take effect from the next period.
subscriptions.cancelsAtPeriodEnd: Cancels at the end of this period
subscriptions.emptyBody: A subscription is created when you provision a school.
subscriptions.activateTitle: End the trial and start the paid plan?
subscriptions.changePlanBody: On a trial the change is immediate; otherwise it starts with the next period (no part-month charges).
subscriptions.noPublishedPlans: No other published plan for this tier.
subscriptions.cancelBody: It stays active until the end of the current period, then ends.
subscriptions.oneTimeFeeValue: One-time fee {amount} on the first invoice
subscriptions.chooseAiBundleBody: Billed every month with the plan. Answers count from the first full calendar month; answers above the bundle are billed on the next invoice.
subscriptions.aiBundleOption: {name}: {answers} answers, {price} a month, {rate} each extra answer
subscriptions.removeAiBundleBody: From the next invoice there is no bundle charge and no charge for extra answers.
subscriptions.overrideBody: Replaces the plan's base price on this school's subscription invoices.
subscriptions.overrideAmountHint: For each billing period, for example 3999.00. GST is added on the invoice.
subscriptions.overrideConsequence: Invoices made from now on use this price instead of the plan's base price. Invoices already made don't change.
subscriptions.removeOverrideBody: Invoices made from now on use the plan's base price again. Invoices already made don't change.
subscriptions.suspendBody: This is a billing suspension: only for a past-due subscription whose 15-day grace period has ended (grace ended {date}). It is not the school suspension on the Overview tab, which is for security or abuse.
subscriptions.suspendSharedConsequence: The school is suspended too: staff can't sign in until you reactivate the subscription after the overdue invoices are paid. Records are kept.
subscriptions.suspendDedicatedConsequence: Only the subscription changes. The school's dedicated environment keeps running; it is not switched off from here.
subscriptions.suspendUnknownConsequence: A school on the shared platform is suspended too, so staff can't sign in until you reactivate the subscription. For a dedicated school only the subscription changes.
subscriptions.examWindowOverride: Today is inside a protected board-exam window and I approve this suspension as platform owner
subscriptions.reactivateBody: Overdue invoices must be paid first. A school suspended for non-payment can sign in again straight away.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Monthly drafts are created automatically. Issue them, record payments or void them here.
invoices.numberingNote: Numbers are given when an invoice is issued, per financial year, for example SOS/2026-27/000123.
invoices.manualPaymentNote: Bank transfers, UPI and cheques are recorded by a billing admin.
invoices.emptyBody: Draft invoices are created on the first day of each month for active subscriptions.
invoices.issueBody: It gets the next invoice number and can no longer be changed.
invoices.discardBody: The draft is deleted. No number is used.
invoices.recordPaymentBody: Balance due: {balance}. Partial payments are allowed.
invoices.amountHint: What reached our account, after TDS.
invoices.referenceHint: UTR, UPI reference or cheque number.
invoices.voidBody: The invoice keeps its number and is marked void. Only unpaid invoices can be voided.
invoices.runBody: Create draft invoices for every active subscription for a month. Running it again for the same month does nothing new.
invoices.runStartedBody: Job status: {status}. Reload the list in a minute to see the drafts.

downloadErrors.invoice_pdf_pending: The PDF is still being prepared. Try again in a minute.
downloadErrors.invoice_draft: Draft invoices have no PDF. Issue the invoice first.

invoices.gstNote: CGST and SGST apply when the school is in the same state as our billing entity; IGST applies otherwise. The GST column shows the split.

payments.title: Payments
payments.emptyBody: Payments recorded against this invoice appear here, newest first.
payments.onlyIssued: Payments are recorded against issued invoices only.
payments.reverseBody: {payment}. Use this when a payment was recorded in error or a cheque bounced. The payment stays on record, marked reversed; it is never deleted.
payments.reverseNote: The school is not told automatically: tell its billing contact yourself. Its Plan & billing page shows the amount as due again. If the due date has passed, the daily billing check marks the subscription past due and its grace period starts; nothing is suspended automatically.
payments.reverseConsequence: The invoice goes back to Issued (unpaid) and its balance due rises by {amount}.

invalid_state.title: Already reversed
invalid_state.body: This payment was reversed already, perhaps by someone else. The list now shows its current status.

not_found.title: Payment not found
not_found.body: It may have been changed by someone else. The list has been reloaded; check it and try again.

usage.title: Usage and quotas
usage.description: Daily totals for each school. Alerts go out at 80% and 100% of plan limits. Counts only, never personal data.
usage.emptyBody: Usage totals appear the day after a school starts using SchoolOS. Try a wider date range.
usage.limitsDescription: Counts for {date}, compared with the limits of the school's current plan.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.description: Turn features on for everyone, for a percentage of schools, or for specific schools. A school's own setting wins.
flags.overridesEmptyBody: Every school follows the global setting.
flags.rolloutHint: Percentage of schools (0–100). Leave empty for all.
flags.keyHint: Lowercase dotted name, for example ask.citations_v2. It cannot change later.
flags.emptyBody: Create a flag to release a feature gradually.
flags.switchHint: Switching a flag asks you to confirm first. Nothing changes until you do.
flags.turnOnBody: Schools without their own override get this feature, within the rollout percentage. It applies within a minute.
flags.turnOffBody: Schools without their own override lose this feature. Schools forced on keep it. It applies within a minute.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Shared and dedicated deployments, their versions and last heartbeat. Heartbeats carry version, health and counts only.
fleet.emptyBody: A deployment record is created when you provision a school.
fleet.versionsEmptyBody: Versions appear after deployments send their first heartbeat.

fleet.customDomainHint: For example office.school.edu.in. TLS is set up on the host.

operators.emptyBody: Invite the people who run billing, support and deployments.

roleHints.support_agent: Support tickets, announcements and access requests.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: Try again. If it keeps happening, contact support and give them the reference below.

invalid_state.title: This can't be done right now
invalid_state.body: The record's status has changed. Reload the page to see its current status.

duplicate.title: This already exists
duplicate.body: Something with the same code, email or reference is already recorded. Check the list before adding it again.

conflict.title: This changed while you were working
conflict.body: Reload the page to see the latest version, then try again.

precondition_failed.title: Someone else changed this first
precondition_failed.body: Reload the page to see their change, then make yours again.

validation_error.title: Some details need attention
validation_error.body: Check the highlighted fields and try again.

forbidden.title: You don't have permission for this
forbidden.body: Ask an administrator to give you the role that allows it.

not_found.title: We couldn't find this
not_found.body: It may have been removed, or the link is wrong. Go back to the list and try again.

plan_published.title: Published plans can't be changed
plan_published.body: Create a new version of the plan instead.

idempotency_in_progress.title: Still working on your last request
idempotency_in_progress.body: Wait a few seconds, then reload the page to see the result.

exam_window.title: Not during board exams
exam_window.body: This school is inside a protected board-exam window. A platform owner must approve suspending it.

grace_not_over.title: The grace period is not over
grace_not_over.body: A past-due subscription can be suspended only after its grace period ends.

last_owner.title: At least one owner must remain
last_owner.body: Give someone else the owner role first.

own_account.title: You can't do this to your own account
own_account.body: Ask another administrator to do it.

own_roles.title: You can't change your own roles
own_roles.body: Ask another platform owner to change them.

owner_exists.title: This school already has an owner
owner_exists.body: Resend the owner's invitation instead of adding another owner.

empty_invoice.title: The invoice has no lines
empty_invoice.body: Add at least one line before issuing it.

invoice_issued.title: Issued invoices can't be changed
invoice_issued.body: Void it with a reason and create a new one.

overdue_invoices.title: There are overdue invoices
overdue_invoices.body: Record the payments or void the invoices first.

ticket_closed.title: This ticket is closed
ticket_closed.body: Open a new ticket if you still need help.

tier_change.title: Plans can't move between tiers here
tier_change.body: Moving between shared and dedicated is a migration project. Choose a plan of the same tier.

shared_tier.title: Not for shared deployments
shared_tier.body: This action is only for dedicated deployments.

already_requested.title: Already requested
already_requested.body: An offboarding request is already waiting for approval.

not_requested.title: Nothing to approve
not_requested.body: No offboarding request is waiting. Reload the page.

billing_suspension.title: Use the subscription for billing suspensions
billing_suspension.body: Non-payment suspensions go through the school's subscription, not this button.

mfa_required.title: Two-step verification is needed
mfa_required.body: Set up two-step verification (MFA) for your account, then sign in again.

tenant_suspended.title: This school's access is paused
tenant_suspended.body: The owner can contact SchoolOS support.

csrf_failed.title: Security check failed
csrf_failed.body: Reload the page and try again.

payload_too_large.title: Too much at once
payload_too_large.body: Send less text at a time and try again.

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.body: Wait a minute, then try again.
rate_limited.bodyWait: Too many requests. Wait {seconds} seconds and try again.

bad_gateway.title: The server is not responding
bad_gateway.body: Check your internet connection and try again in a minute.

tenant_not_available.title: You can't open this school
tenant_not_available.body: Ask the school's office admin to give you access.

provisioning_in_progress.title: Setup is already running
provisioning_in_progress.body: Another request is setting up this school right now. Wait a few minutes, then reload the page.

provisioning_incomplete.title: The school's setup is not finished
provisioning_incomplete.body: A school can go live only after setup finishes. Select "Resume provisioning" on the school's page, then try again.

provisioning_failed.title: Setup stopped before it finished
provisioning_failed.body: Nothing is lost. Reload the school's page and select "Resume provisioning" to continue.

resume_needs_request.title: This setup can't be resumed from here
resume_needs_request.body: It was started before setup could be resumed. Open "Provision school" and submit the same details again to finish it.

api.redirecting: Taking you to sign in so you can confirm it's you…
api.unavailable: This isn't available on this deployment.

step_up_cancelled.title: Not done: we still need to confirm it's you
step_up_cancelled.body: This action needs a fresh sign-in with your second step (MFA). Try again and choose "Sign in again".

structure_archived.title: This is archived
structure_archived.body: The academic year, class or section is archived. Ask the office to unarchive it on the school structure page, then try again.

structure_in_use.title: Students are still enrolled here
structure_in_use.body: This can't be archived while students are enrolled in it. Move the students first, then try again.

export_already_confirmed.title: The export is already confirmed
export_already_confirmed.body: Deletion has been scheduled. Reload the page to see its progress.

not_dedicated.title: This school is not on a dedicated host
not_dedicated.body: Shared-tier schools are deleted by SchoolOS automatically; there is no host to tear down.

not_offboarding.title: This school is not being offboarded
not_offboarding.body: Two operators must request and approve offboarding first.

certificate_pending.title: The certificate is not ready yet
certificate_pending.body: It is issued a few minutes after the keys are destroyed. Try again later.

rotation_pending.title: A key rotation is already in progress
rotation_pending.body: The new heartbeat key is valid now and the old one keeps working for 7 days. Rotate again after that.

already_on_hold.title: This school is already on a security hold
already_on_hold.body: Reload the page to see its current state.

value_out_of_range.title: The number or date is too large
value_out_of_range.body: This number or date is too large. Check it and try again.

stepUp.body: For your security, this action needs you to sign in again with your second step (MFA). A small window will open. What you typed on this page is kept.

stepUp.completeBody: Go back to the SchoolOS window. Your action continues there. You can close this window.

Access is read-only, ends by itself, and every screen they open is written to your audit log. You can end it at any time.
breakGlass.waitingCount: {count, plural, one {# request is waiting for your decision.} other {# requests are waiting for your decision.}}
breakGlass.noAccessTitle: Only the owner and the principal can see this

breakGlass.scopeIgnored: Also sent by SchoolOS, but these do not limit what they can see: {items}.

invalid_state.body: It was already decided, or it has ended. Reload the page to see its status.

request_expired.title: This request is too old
request_expired.body: Requests expire after 24 hours. Ask SchoolOS support to send a new one if they still need access.

request_withdrawn.title: SchoolOS support withdrew this request
request_withdrawn.body: Nothing needs to be done. Reload the page to see its status.

operator_inactive.title: The person who asked can no longer sign in
operator_inactive.body: Deny this request. SchoolOS support can send a new one if needed.

detail.readOnly: Read-only: they cannot change anything. Every screen they open is written to the audit log.
detail.activeTitle: Support can see your records now

detail.denyBody: SchoolOS support gets no access. You will be asked to confirm it's you.
detail.revokeBody: Support loses access immediately. You will be asked to confirm it's you.

exports.descriptionSchoolPeriod: Pre-check reports for boards and portals, and student lists. Files are deleted when your school's retention period ends; each export shows the date.
exports.noAccessBody: Exports are for staff who make board or portal pre-checks or student lists. Ask your school's office admin if you need this.

list.mineHint: Exports you asked for, newest first.
list.wholeSchoolHint: Every export made in this school, newest first. You can see who made each one; downloading someone else's file needs separate permission.
list.updating: Some exports are still being made. This list updates by itself.

precheck.title: Pre-check before you submit
precheck.body: Check students against a board registration or portal format. You get the problems to fix first and a sheet in the portal's field order.

studentList.title: Student list
studentList.body: Choose the columns and students for an Excel or CSV file of student details.

scope.hint: Only students you are allowed to see are included, from the current academic year. One export can have up to 2,000 students.

scope.everyone: All students the requester could see

new.stepUpTitle: You will be asked to confirm it's you
new.stepUpBody: Exports carry many students' personal details. When you press the button at the end, SchoolOS asks you to sign in again with your second step (MFA) if you have not done so in the last 5 minutes. Your choices on this page are kept, and the export starts as soon as you have confirmed.
new.languageHint: Headings and labels in the file use this language. Student details stay as recorded.

precheck.title: New pre-check
precheck.description: Check students against a board or portal format before you submit. The report lists the problems to fix first and a "ready to enter" sheet in the portal's field order.
precheck.noPermissionBody: Board and portal pre-checks are for staff with export permission, such as the exam coordinator. Ask your school's office admin if you need this.
precheck.profilesErrorBody: Check your internet connection and reload the page. If it keeps happening, contact support.
precheck.noProfilesBody: None of the board or portal formats is open to your role. Ask your school's office admin if you need one.
precheck.profileHint: Choose the board registration or portal you are preparing for.
precheck.fieldsIntro: The "ready to enter" sheet has these fields, in this order:
precheck.formatsHint: Choose at least one. The Excel file has the full findings and the "ready to enter" sheet; the PDF is for printing.

precheck.sensitiveGeneric: Some formats have restricted details, such as category. They are hidden (••••) in the file unless you include them.

precheck.sensitiveWarning: Include them only if you must enter them in the portal. Your choice and the restricted columns included are recorded in the audit log, and the file must be kept safe.

studentList.title: New student list
studentList.description: Choose the columns and students for a spreadsheet of student details.
studentList.noPermissionBody: Student lists are for staff allowed to export student details. Ask your school's office admin if you need this.
studentList.columnsHint: Choose only what you need, up to {max}. Columns appear in this order.
studentList.columnsPartial: Only class, section and roll number can be offered right now. Reload the page to see the other columns.
studentList.aadhaarNote: Aadhaar details as printed are never exported. The Aadhaar reference shows only the last 4 digits.
studentList.restrictedWarning: Columns marked restricted are recorded in the audit log when you include them. Keep the file safe.
studentList.formatHint: Excel (XLSX) for working in a spreadsheet; CSV for uploading to other systems.

detail.title: Export
detail.notFoundBody: It may belong to someone else, or the link is wrong. Open it from your exports list.
detail.loadErrorBody: Check your internet connection and reload the page. If it keeps happening, contact support.
detail.retentionNote: Files are deleted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after they are ready. This record of who exported what stays.
detail.retentionNoteSchoolPeriod: Files are deleted when your school's retention period ends. This record of who exported what stays.
detail.linkNote: Each download uses a new link that works for a few minutes only. Every download is recorded in the audit log.
detail.busyBody: This can take a few minutes for a large batch. You can leave this page: you will get a notification when the files are ready.
detail.failedTitle: This export could not be made
detail.expiredBody: The files were deleted when your school's retention period ended. Make a new export to get up-to-date files.
detail.noLongerTitle: You can no longer download this export
detail.noLongerBody: Your permissions have changed since you made it. Ask your school's office admin if you still need it.
detail.notOwnTitle: Only the person who made it can download this
detail.notOwnBody: You can see that this export exists, but not its files. Ask the person who made it, or make a new one yourself.

failure.no_students: No students matched when the file was being made. Check the classes or sections and make a new export.
failure.permission_revoked: The requester's permissions changed before the file was ready. Make a new export if you still need it.
failure.sensitive_not_allowed: Restricted details were asked for by someone no longer allowed to see them. Make a new export without them.
failure.worker_error: Something went wrong on our side. Make a new export; if it fails again, contact support.
failure.other: Something went wrong. Make a new export; if it fails again, contact support.

not_own_export.title: Only the person who made it can download this
not_own_export.body: Ask the person who made the export, or make a new one yourself.

export_not_ready.title: The files are not ready yet
export_not_ready.body: Wait until the status says ready, then try again. This page updates by itself.

export_failed.title: This export could not be made
export_failed.body: There are no files to download. Make a new export.

export_expired.title: The files have been deleted
export_expired.body: The files were deleted when your school's retention period ended. Make a new export.

sensitive_not_allowed.title: Restricted details are not allowed for you
sensitive_not_allowed.body: Only staff allowed to see restricted details (such as category) can include or download them. Leave them out, or ask your school's office admin.

devSignIn.title: Dev sign-in
devSignIn.localOnly: Local development only. This page does not exist in staging or production, and it does not skip any sign-in check.

steps.copy: Copy the subject of the person you want to be.
steps.signIn: Select Sign in. The local sign-in page opens.
steps.paste: Paste the subject in the user box and select Sign-in. Leave the claims box empty.

devSignIn.mfaNote: The local sign-in page marks every sign-in as two-step verified (MFA), so owner, principal and office admin work without extra claims. SchoolOS still checks MFA as in production.
devSignIn.more: {count} people: change the last number (1 to {count})
devSignIn.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the subject and copy it yourself.

stepUp.title: Confirming it's you (step-up)
stepUp.body: Some actions ask you to sign in again. The local sign-in page does not add the sign-in time by itself, so copy these claims just before, paste them in its claims box and sign in with the same subject. They are valid for 5 minutes.

operators.title: Platform operators
operators.body: Operators are not seeded. Create the first one with app.platform.bootstrap_owner, then sign in at /platform with that subject.

academicStructure.readOnlyNote: You can see the school structure. Only the owner, principal or office admin can add or change academic years, classes and sections.

years.addDescription: Add one academic year at a time. Academic years cannot share any days.
years.labelHint: The year it starts, a hyphen, then the last two digits of the next year. For example 2026-27.
years.makeCurrentHint: Only one year can be current. The year that is current now will stop being current.
years.makeCurrentBody: Only one year can be current. The year that is current now will stop being current, and {label} will be shown as the current year everywhere.

classes.addDescription: Add a class with its name in English and Telugu.
classes.codeHint: Capital letters, digits, _ or -, for example NUR, LKG, 1 or 10. Exports and registers use this code, so it cannot be changed later.
classes.orderHint: Classes with smaller numbers come first. Use a whole number from 0 to 10000.
classes.codeFixed: Class code {code}. The code cannot be changed.
classes.defaultsBody: This adds any missing classes from Nursery to Class XII, with English and Telugu names. Classes you already have stay as they are.

sections.description: Sections belong to one class in one academic year.
sections.addDescription: Choose the class, then type the section name.
sections.nameHint: Up to 16 characters, for example A or Rose.
sections.needYear: Add an academic year first. Sections are set up for each academic year.
sections.needClass: Add classes first, then add sections to them.
sections.teacherHint: Optional. The class teacher can see this section's students.
sections.teacherUnavailable: The staff list can't be shown, so the class teacher can't be chosen here. You can still save the other details; the class teacher stays as it is.
sections.teacherNotListed: Someone not in the staff list
sections.archivedYearNote: This academic year is archived. Unarchive it to add sections to it.

academic_year_overlap.title: These dates overlap another academic year
academic_year_overlap.body: Academic years cannot share any days. Change the start or end date so they do not overlap, then try again.

precondition_failed.title: Someone else changed this first
precondition_failed.body: The list now shows their change. Close this window, open it again and make your change.

duplicate.title: This already exists
duplicate.body: There is already a class with this code, or a section with this name in the same class and year. Check the list before adding it again.

academic_year_current.title: The current year can't be archived
academic_year_current.body: Make another academic year current first, then archive this one.

structure_in_use.title: Students are still enrolled here
structure_in_use.body: This can't be archived while students are enrolled in it. Move or promote the students first, then try again.

structure_archived.title: This is archived
structure_archived.body: The academic year or class is archived. Turn on "Show archived", unarchive it, then try again.

promotion_already_committed.title: This year was already promoted
promotion_already_committed.body: Students of this year were already moved to the next year. To change that, undo the promotion first (within 24 hours).

promotion_plan_changed.title: Enrolments changed since the preview
promotion_plan_changed.body: Someone changed students' sections after you previewed. Close this window, select "Preview promotion" again and check the new plan.

nothing_to_promote.title: No student can be promoted
nothing_to_promote.body: Every student of this year has left, graduated or is already enrolled in the new year. Nothing was changed.

no_target_section.title: Some students have no section in the new year
no_target_section.body: Add the missing sections to the new year on the school structure page, or choose a section for them under "Sections in the new year", then preview again.

promotion_undo_expired.title: It's too late to undo
promotion_undo_expired.body: A promotion can be undone only within 24 hours. Correct the students one by one from their records instead.

promotion_has_dependents.title: This promotion can't be undone
promotion_has_dependents.body: Some of these students' enrolments or records were changed after the promotion. Correct those students one by one from their records instead.

no_promotion.title: There is nothing to undo
no_promotion.body: This year has no promotion that can be undone. Reload the page to see its current state.

promotion_held_back_not_in_year.title: A chosen student is not in this year
promotion_held_back_not_in_year.body: One of the students you chose is not enrolled in this academic year. Remove them from "Students who stay in the same class" and preview again.

promotion_target_not_later.title: Choose a later year
promotion_target_not_later.body: Students can only be promoted into an academic year that starts after this one. Choose another year.

promotion_target_not_found.title: That academic year no longer exists
promotion_target_not_found.body: Reload the page and choose the year to promote into again.

promotion_section_map_invalid.title: Check the section choices
promotion_section_map_invalid.body: One of the chosen sections no longer exists or was chosen twice. Reload the page and choose the sections again.

academicStructure.showArchived: Show archived years, classes and sections
academicStructure.showArchivedHint: Archived items are hidden from lists but kept for old records.

archive.unarchiveBody: It shows in lists again and can be used for new records.

year.title: Archive academic year {name}?
year.body: The year is hidden from lists but kept for old records. The current year, or a year that still has students enrolled, can't be archived.

class.title: Archive {name}?
class.body: The class is hidden from lists but kept for old records. A class with students enrolled in any of its sections can't be archived.

section.title: Archive section {name}?
section.body: The section is hidden from lists but kept for old records. A section with students enrolled can't be archived: move them to another section first.

archive.inUse: Students are enrolled, so it can't be archived

promotions.title: Promote students of {label}
promotions.description: Move students to the next class for the new academic year. Nothing changes until you select "Promote students" after the preview.
promotions.noAccessBody: Only people who can manage the school structure (for example the principal or office admin) can promote students to the next year.
promotions.notYet: Students of this year have not been promoted yet.
promotions.doneTitle: Students of this year were promoted
promotions.undoExpired: More than 24 hours have passed, so this promotion can't be undone. Correct students one by one from their records.
promotions.undoBody: Students go back to their classes and sections in {from}. Their new enrolments are removed and graduates get their earlier status back. This is recorded in the audit log.
promotions.planDescription: Each class goes to the next class by class order and the last class graduates. Students who left are skipped.
promotions.noTargetTitle: Add the next academic year first
promotions.noTargetBody: There is no academic year that starts after {label}. Add it and its sections on the school structure page, then come back.
promotions.targetHint: The academic year the students move to.
promotions.heldBackTitle: Students who stay in the same class
promotions.heldBackHint: Find each student who is not promoted this year. They stay in the same class in the new year.
promotions.searchHint: Type part of a name or an admission number.
promotions.searchHintNotCurrent: Search finds students of the current academic year only, so it may not find students of this year.
promotions.searchResults: {count, plural, =0 {No students of this year match.} one {# student of this year matches.} other {# students of this year match.}}
promotions.noStudentRead: You can't see student records, so you can't choose students here. Ask someone who can, or promote everyone.
promotions.heldBackCount: {count, plural, one {# student stays in the same class} other {# students stay in the same class}}
promotions.mapHint: {year} has no section with the same name for these students. Choose where they go.
promotions.mapNone: {year} has no section of {className} yet. Add one on the school structure page.
promotions.stale: You changed the plan after this preview. Select "Preview promotion" again before promoting.
promotions.problemsTitle: {count, plural, one {# student has no section in the new year} other {# students have no section in the new year}}
promotions.problemsFix: Choose a section for them under "Sections in the new year" and preview again, or add the sections on the school structure page.

reason.already_enrolled: Already enrolled in the new year
reason.no_target_section: No section in the new year

promotions.commitNeedsPreview: Preview again to promote with the plan as it is now.
promotions.cannotCommit: Fix the problems above and preview again before promoting.
promotions.indexDescription: At the end of a year, move its students to the next class. Choose the year whose students you are promoting; you see a preview before anything changes.

schoolSettings.title: School settings
schoolSettings.description: Your school's details and the settings that apply to everyone in the school.
schoolSettings.readOnlyNote: You can see these settings. Only the owner or principal can change them.

profile.title: School details
profile.description: SchoolOS sets these when your school joins. To change them, contact SchoolOS support.
profile.name: School name

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Languages, date format, sign-out time and AI features.

form.idleField: Sign out after this many idle minutes
form.aiHint: Turn off to stop AI features for everyone in the school.
form.memoryToggle: Let Ask remember each person's preferences
form.memoryHint: Ask can remember how each person works, such as the classes they teach or the language they prefer, never facts about students or staff. Turn off to stop it for everyone; each person can also turn it off for themselves.
form.nothingChanged: Nothing changed, so there was nothing to save.

precondition_failed.title: Someone else changed these settings first
precondition_failed.body: Select “Load the latest settings” to see their change, then make yours again.

languages.title: Languages and dates
languages.description: The languages your school uses and how dates are written.

session.title: Signing out
session.description: Staff are signed out after this many idle minutes, so records stay safe on shared office computers.

ai.title: AI features
ai.description: Turn AI help on or off for everyone and set a monthly limit on its cost.

saveBar.title: Save your changes
saveBar.body: Changes apply to everyone in the school once you save.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Circulars, policies, meeting minutes and other school documents. Every file is checked for viruses before anyone can open it.
documents.noAccessBody: Documents are for staff with document access. Ask your school's office admin if you need this.

C1.hint: For school staff only, with no personal details (for example a holiday circular).

C2.hint: Names or other details of students, parents or staff (for example a class list).

C3.hint: Sensitive details such as health, category, income or identity papers. Only staff allowed to see sensitive data, and the person who uploaded it, can open the file.

reason.busy: SchoolOS is checking this file. It can be opened once the check has passed, usually within a few minutes. This page updates by itself.
reason.malware_detected: The virus check found a threat in this file, so it was blocked and cannot be opened. Check the file on your computer with your antivirus, then upload a clean copy as a new version.
reason.aadhaar_detected: This file showed a full Aadhaar number, so SchoolOS keeps it from being opened. SchoolOS never shows or stores full Aadhaar numbers. Upload a copy with the number covered, showing only the last 4 digits.
reason.aadhaar_redacted: This file showed a full Aadhaar number. SchoolOS saved a copy with the number hidden as the next version and removed this one. Use the newer version.
reason.aadhaar_unredactable: This file showed a full Aadhaar number that SchoolOS could not hide, so the file was removed. Upload a copy with the number covered, showing only the last 4 digits.
reason.scan_unavailable: The virus check could not be done, so the file cannot be opened. Upload it again as a new version. If it happens again, contact SchoolOS support.
reason.storage_unavailable: The file could not be read for the virus check. Upload it again as a new version. If it happens again, contact SchoolOS support.
reason.quarantined_other: This file was blocked and cannot be opened. Upload a new version, or contact SchoolOS support if you are not sure why.
reason.failed_other: This file could not be checked, so it cannot be opened. Upload it again as a new version. If it happens again, contact SchoolOS support.

list.updating: Some files are still being checked. This list updates by itself.
list.emptyBody: Documents you are allowed to see will be listed here.
list.emptyBodyUploader: Upload circulars, policies and other documents with the button above.
list.emptyFilteredBody: Choose other filters, or clear them to see every document you can see.
list.deletedBody: The document and all its versions were deleted. Its files are removed from storage shortly.
list.libraryHint: Newest first. Choose a type, group or archived documents, then press Apply filters.

detail.title: Document
detail.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or you may not be allowed to see it. Go back to the list and choose it again.
detail.loadErrorBody: Check your internet connection and reload the page. If it keeps happening, contact support.
detail.stillChecking: A file is still being checked. This page updates by itself.
detail.restrictedBody: This file has sensitive details. Only staff allowed to see sensitive data, and the person who uploaded it, can open it. Ask your school's office admin if you need it.
detail.olderReady: The newest version cannot be opened yet, so this downloads version {version}, the newest one that passed the virus check.

detail.nothingReady: No version of this document can be opened yet.
detail.versionsHint: Every upload is kept as a version. The newest version is used by default.
detail.aclHint: Staff also need document access for their role. Class teachers see only documents for their own classes or sections.
detail.deleteHint: Deleting removes every version and its files. It cannot be undone.
detail.formerMember: A staff member who is no longer in this school
detail.archivedBody: It is kept with all its versions and can still be opened, but it is listed only under "Archived". To change its details or add a version, unarchive it first.

acl.hint: Choose the whole school, or only some roles, classes, sections or staff members. Class teachers must choose their own classes or sections.
acl.wholeSchool: Everyone in the school with document access.
acl.limitedTo: Only these staff (if they also have document access):

aclEdit.title: Change who can see this document
aclEdit.description: The change applies right away and is recorded in the audit log.

newVersion.title: Upload a new version
newVersion.description: The earlier versions are kept. The new one can be opened once it passes the virus check.
newVersion.fileHint: Use the same kind of file as before. At most 25 MB.

delete.title: Delete this document?
delete.description: Every version and its files will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.body: You are deleting "{title}". Documents still used as evidence for a student's record cannot be deleted.

new.title: Upload a document
new.description: Add a circular, policy, meeting minutes or another school document. The file is checked for viruses before anyone can open it.
new.noPermissionBody: Uploading documents is for staff with upload permission. Ask your school's office admin if you need this.
new.fileHint: PDF, JPG, PNG, Word (DOCX) or Excel (XLSX), at most 25 MB.
new.titleHint: A short name staff will recognise, for example "Dasara holidays circular 2026". No student's personal details.
new.languageHint: The language the document is written in.
new.issuerHint: For example the school, the board or the district office.
new.issuedOnHint: The date printed on the document, if it has one.
new.sensitivityHint: Choose the highest that applies. It decides who may open the file.
new.scanNote: After you upload, SchoolOS checks the file for viruses. You can open it once the check has passed, usually within a few minutes.
new.dropTitle: Choose the file, or drag it here

document_in_use.title: This document must be kept
document_in_use.body: It is used as evidence for a student's record, or the school's retention rules keep it. It cannot be deleted.

document_not_ready.title: The file cannot be opened yet
document_not_ready.body: It has not passed the virus check. Wait a few minutes and try again; this page updates by itself.

sensitive_document.title: This file is restricted
sensitive_document.body: Only staff allowed to see sensitive data, and the person who uploaded it, can open it. Ask your school's office admin if you need it.

duplicate_document.title: This file is already uploaded
duplicate_document.body: The same file is already in the documents list. Open that document instead, or upload a new version of it.

unsupported_file_type.title: This type of file is not accepted
unsupported_file_type.body: Upload a PDF, JPG, PNG, Word (DOCX) or Excel (XLSX) file. Check that the name ends with the right extension, for example .pdf.

file_too_large.title: The file is too large
file_too_large.body: Files can be at most 25 MB. Scan at a lower resolution or split the document, then try again.

upload_expired.title: The upload took too long
upload_expired.body: Choose the file again and press upload. On a slow connection, try a smaller file.

upload_already_used.title: This upload was already saved
upload_already_used.body: Go back to the documents list to find it. To add the file again, choose it and upload once more.

upload_missing.title: The file did not arrive
upload_missing.body: Check your internet connection, choose the file again and press upload.

upload_changed.title: The file changed during the upload
upload_changed.body: Choose the file again and press upload.

storage_unavailable.title: The file could not be saved
storage_unavailable.body: Try again in a few minutes. If it keeps happening, contact SchoolOS support.

version_conflict.title: Someone added a version just now
version_conflict.body: Reload the page to see it, then upload your file again if it is still needed.

version_unchanged.title: This is the same file
version_unchanged.body: The file is the same as the newest version, so nothing was added.

not_versionable.title: No new versions for this document
not_versionable.body: Spreadsheet imports cannot get new versions. Start a new import instead.

document_archived.title: This document is archived
document_archived.body: Its details can't be changed while it is archived. Reload the page, unarchive it, then try again.

edit.title: Edit the document's details
edit.description: The file and who can see it do not change. The change is recorded in the audit log.
edit.typeFixed: This kind of document has only one type.
edit.issuerHint: For example the school, the board or the district office. Leave it empty to remove it.

security.title: Security and privacy
security.headline: Built for children's data from the first line of code
security.intro: Student records are some of the most sensitive data a school holds. Here is how SchoolOS keeps them safe, private and in India.

where.title: Where your data lives
where.body: Your school's records and files are stored in Amazon Web Services in Mumbai. Encrypted backups are copied to Hyderabad. Data is stored in India on both plans.

isolation.title: Each school kept apart
isolation.body: Every school's records are separated in the database itself, so a request for one school can never read another school's data. On the Dedicated plan your school also runs in its own managed, isolated environment with a dedicated database, storage and key.

encryption.title: Encrypted in transit and at rest
encryption.body: Connections use TLS. Databases, files and backups are encrypted with managed keys, and the most sensitive fields are encrypted again with your school's own key.

aadhaar.title: No Aadhaar numbers
aadhaar.body: SchoolOS stores only the last 4 digits and the details as printed on the card. A full Aadhaar number found in an upload or in text is masked.

access.title: The right people, the right records
access.body: Roles and scopes decide who sees what: a class teacher sees their own sections. Sensitive actions such as exports ask for a fresh sign-in with a second factor.

audit.title: An audit log that cannot be edited
audit.body: Changes to student details, role changes, exports, sign-ins and questions asked are recorded in a hash-chained log that your school can check for tampering.

logs.title: No personal data in logs
logs.body: Our system logs carry IDs and codes, not names, dates of birth or phone numbers.

ai.title: AI that stays inside the lines
ai.body: Ask the school uses AI to write answers, under strict rules.
ai.filter: Records the person asking may not see are filtered out before the AI reads anything.
ai.sources: Every answer cites the passages it used, or says it was not found in the school records.
ai.readOnly: AI tools are read-only. Any change still needs a person, through the normal screens.
ai.training: Your school's data is not used to train AI models, and AI requests are processed in India.

support.title: No standing access for SchoolOS staff
support.body: Our staff cannot open your school's records on their own. When we need to look at something to help you, your school decides.

request.title: We ask
request.body: A request names the reason, what we need to see and for how long, up to 8 hours.

approve.title: Your school approves
approve.body: Your owner or principal approves it with a fresh sign-in, or does not.

access.title: Read-only, for a limited time
access.body: Access is read-only, ends on its own and can be revoked by your school at any time.

record.title: Every screen recorded
record.body: Everything our staff open is written to your school's audit log.

support.emergency: The only exception is a legal obligation or an active security incident: two SchoolOS staff must confirm it, and your school is told straight away.

privacy.title: Your school decides, SchoolOS processes
privacy.body: Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, your school decides why student data is used and SchoolOS processes it only on your school's instructions, under a data processing agreement.
privacy.purpose: Student data is used for school administration, education and safety only: no advertising, no selling, no marketing.
privacy.export: The owner can export every record, document and the audit log at any time.
privacy.exit: If you leave, your data is deleted within 30 days, its keys are destroyed and you receive a certificate of deletion.

pricing.title: Pricing

pricing.intro: There is no price list. We agree the fee with each school in writing before it starts. This page explains what the fee is based on, what every school gets and what happens after you get in touch.
pricing.priceNote: Quoted in writing for your school

shared.name: Shared
shared.summary: Your school runs as a separate, isolated school on the managed SchoolOS platform in AWS Mumbai.
shared.for: Most schools. Nothing to install and nothing to look after.

points.two: Managed, updated and backed up by SchoolOS
points.three: Works in a browser on your office PCs
points.four: Web address on the SchoolOS domain

dedicated.name: Dedicated
dedicated.summary: A managed, isolated SchoolOS environment with your own domain, a dedicated database and a documented data export. We run it for you in AWS Mumbai.
dedicated.for: Larger schools, school groups and schools that want their own environment and web address.

points.two: A dedicated database, storage and encryption key
points.four: Web address on your school's own domain

compare.title: Compare the plans
compare.caption: Shared and Dedicated plans compared
compare.serverDedicated: Managed, isolated environment with a dedicated database
compare.keyShared: Your school's own key for sensitive fields
compare.keyDedicated: Your own key for the whole environment

price.q: Why are there no prices on this page?
price.a: Schools differ in size, campuses and how they will use SchoolOS, so we quote each school in writing before it starts. Talk to us and we will explain every part of it plainly.

switch.q: What does a school need to get started?
switch.a: A browser on your office PCs and the student lists you already keep. On the Shared plan there is nothing to install.

features.a: No. Both plans have every feature and the same security. Dedicated adds a managed, isolated environment with a dedicated database, storage and key, and a web address on your own domain.

data.q: Where is our data on each plan?
data.a: In India on both: AWS Mumbai, with encrypted backups in Hyderabad.

ai.q: What happens if we use up our questions?
ai.a: Everything else keeps working. You can add extra answers for the rest of the month or move to a bigger bundle from the next month.

everyone.title: What every school gets
everyone.intro: On both plans, whatever the size of the school.

items.reconciliation: A reconciliation with your office before go-live

ai.intro: Answers from your own records and documents, with sources, come in a monthly bundle of questions. You choose the bundle that fits how your staff work, and can change it later.

lite.name: Lite
lite.body: For an office that asks now and then, such as before a board submission.

standard.name: Standard
standard.body: For everyday use by the office and the principal.

high.name: High
high.body: For schools where many staff ask questions every day.

extra.name: Extra answers

billing.cycle: The subscription is billed monthly or annually, in advance, as agreed in your quote.
billing.oneTime: The implementation and data verification fee is invoiced once.
billing.gst: GST is shown separately on every tax invoice, never hidden inside the fee.
billing.invoices: Each tax invoice from SchoolOS lists the service period and every fee on its own line.

demo.title: We show you SchoolOS
demo.body: A walk-through on sample data. We never ask for real student records before you sign up.

quote.title: You get a written quote
quote.body: The recurring fee, the one-time implementation fee and the AI bundle, each shown on its own, with GST shown separately.

start.title: We set up and verify
start.body: Once you agree, we set up your school, verify your records with your office and invite the school's owner to sign in.

about.title: About
about.headline: Software for the school office, built with the office
about.intro: SchoolOS is a managed service for private schools in India, starting in Andhra Pradesh. We run it, keep it secure and keep it up to date, so your office can get on with the work.

who.title: Who it is for
who.body: Office clerks, principals, management, accountants, exam coordinators and teachers: busy people on shared office PCs, often with patchy internet. SchoolOS is designed for them, in plain language.

register.title: The register is the legal record
register.body: SchoolOS points out differences. It never corrects an official record on its own.

evidence.title: Every change can be traced
evidence.body: Corrections need evidence and a second person, and they are recorded for good.

grounded.title: Answers show their sources
grounded.body: If an answer is not in your school's records, SchoolOS says so.

children.title: Children's data is for education
children.body: Student data is used for school administration, education and safety. Never for advertising or marketing.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about SchoolOS, a demonstration on sample data or pricing: write to us.

dedicated.title: Sign in
dedicated.headline: Sign in to your school office
dedicated.body: This is your school's own SchoolOS. Sign in with the account your school gave you.
dedicated.help: Can't sign in? Ask your school office to send the invitation again.

devUi.intro: Every SchoolOS primitive and variant with synthetic content. Screens use these components; docs/17-ui-design-system.md explains when to use which.
