dataExport.title: Data export
dataExport.description: Download all of your school's records, documents and audit log in one file. Only the owner can do this.
dataExport.ownerOnlyTitle: Only the owner can export all data
dataExport.ownerOnlyBody: Exporting everything the school holds is kept for the school's owner. Ask the owner if you need a copy of the school's data.
dataExport.requestDescription: SchoolOS prepares one ZIP file in the background. You will get a notification when it is ready.

includes.records: Every record table as a CSV file (opens in Excel) and a JSON file: students with the values from every source, guardians, enrolments, corrections, data checks, imports, staff and school structure.
includes.documents: Every uploaded document that passed the virus check.
includes.audit: The school's audit log as a CSV file, and a list of what is in the file.
includes.never: Full Aadhaar numbers are never stored, so they are never in the file. The name, date of birth and gender as printed on Aadhaar are never exported.

dataExport.sensitiveHint: Health notes, category, caste, religion, guardian phone numbers and addresses and the last four Aadhaar digits. Without this they show as ••••. The audit log records that they were included.
dataExport.sensitiveNotAllowed: Restricted details (health notes, category, guardian phone numbers) will show as ••••. Only staff allowed to see them for the whole school can include them.
dataExport.careTitle: This file holds children's personal data
dataExport.careBody: Keep it on a secure computer, do not email it, and delete copies you no longer need. The file is deleted from SchoolOS 24 hours after it is ready.
dataExport.busyNote: An export is being made. Wait for it to finish.
dataExport.requested: Your export has been requested. This page updates while it is being made.
dataExport.busyBody: Large schools can take several minutes. You can leave this page; you will be notified when it is ready.
dataExport.readyBody: You can download the file until {expires}. After that it is deleted and you can make a new one.
dataExport.failedTitle: The export could not be made
dataExport.expiredBody: Full exports are deleted 24 hours after they are ready. Make a new export to get up-to-date data.
dataExport.linkNote: The download link works for 5 minutes. Press the button again for a new link.
dataExport.historyDescription: Every full export of the school: who asked for it and when. The record stays after the file is deleted.

failure.permission_revoked: The person who asked for it is no longer allowed to export all data. The owner can make a new export.
failure.too_large: The school's documents are too large for one file. Contact SchoolOS support: they can prepare the export in parts.
failure.too_many_audit_events: The audit log is too long for one file. Contact SchoolOS support.
failure.integrity_mismatch: A stored document did not match its check, so the file was not made. Contact SchoolOS support.
failure.worker_error: Something went wrong on our side. Make a new export; if it fails again, contact support.
failure.other: Something went wrong. Make a new export; if it fails again, contact support.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: How long SchoolOS keeps working data before deleting it. You can shorten these periods; SchoolOS never keeps data longer than the limits shown.
retention.notAllowedTitle: Only the owner and principal can see this
retention.notAllowedBody: Retention settings are part of the school settings. Ask your owner or principal.
retention.editableDescription: A daily job deletes this data when the period is over.
retention.fixedDescription: These periods are set by law, for security, or by how the feature works, and cannot be changed here.
retention.recordsNote: Student records, admission registers and documents you upload are never deleted automatically. They are kept as your school's records.
retention.saveBody: Shorter periods apply from the next daily clean-up. The change is recorded in the audit log.

outcome.unchanged: Nothing changed, so nothing was saved.

import_raw_files.name: Uploaded import files
import_raw_files.about: Spreadsheets uploaded to add students. The values added to student records stay.

exports.name: Export files
exports.about: Pre-check reports and student lists made on the Exports screen. The record of who exported what stays.

notifications_read.name: Read notifications
notifications_read.about: Notifications you have already opened. Unread ones are kept.

tenant_exports.name: Full data export file
tenant_exports.about: The file made on the Data export screen. It can be downloaded for 24 hours.

kb_queries.name: Ask the school questions and answers
kb_queries.about: Questions asked in Ask the school and their answers, kept encrypted.

audit_events.name: Audit log
audit_events.about: Who did what and when. Kept at least 13 months as the law requires, then archived.

behaviour_notes.name: Behaviour notes
behaviour_notes.about: Notes teachers write about a student. Deleted a year after the note's date.

closed_flags.name: Closed follow-up flags
closed_flags.about: Early-warning flags and what was done about them. Deleted a year after the flag is closed; open flags are kept.

tenant_export_in_progress.title: An export is already being made
tenant_export_in_progress.body: Wait until it is ready, then download it or make a new one.

sensitive_not_allowed.title: You can't include restricted details
sensitive_not_allowed.body: Only staff allowed to see restricted details for the whole school can include them. Make the export without them.

export_not_ready.title: The export is not ready yet
export_not_ready.body: Wait a moment and try again. This page updates on its own.

export_failed.title: The export could not be made
export_failed.body: Make a new export. If it fails again, contact SchoolOS support.

export_expired.title: This file has been deleted
export_expired.body: Full exports are deleted 24 hours after they are ready. Make a new export.

precondition_failed.title: Someone else changed these settings first
precondition_failed.body: Select “Load the latest settings” to see their change, then make yours again.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.description: Transfer, bonafide, study and conduct certificates made from the checked student record. Each one gets a serial number and a line in the register.
certificates.noSerialYet: Gets its serial number when approved
certificates.emptyBodyIssuer: Nothing matches these filters. To issue one, open a student and choose “Issue a certificate”.

inputs.promotion: Qualified for promotion to a higher class

certificate_blocked.title: This certificate cannot be issued yet
certificate_blocked.body: Something it prints needs fixing first. Check the preview: resolve the finding or request a correction, then try again.

certificate_not_pending.title: This certificate was already decided
certificate_not_pending.body: Reload the page to see what happened.

certificate_not_issued.title: Only issued certificates can be copied or cancelled
certificate_not_issued.body: Reload the page to see the certificate's status.

transfer_certificate_exists.title: This student already has a transfer certificate
transfer_certificate_exists.body: A TC is issued or waiting for approval. Open the student's certificates instead of preparing another one. For a lost TC, issue a duplicate.

duplicate_pending.title: A duplicate is already waiting
duplicate_pending.body: Wait for the principal to decide it first.

self_approval_forbidden.title: Someone else must decide this
self_approval_forbidden.body: You prepared this certificate, so another person with approval rights must approve or reject it.

not_requester.title: Only the person who prepared it can withdraw it
not_requester.body: Ask them to withdraw it, or ask the principal to reject it.

no_current_academic_year.title: Set the current academic year first
no_current_academic_year.body: Serial numbers run per academic year. Mark one year as current in Settings, School structure.

pdf_not_ready.title: The PDF is still being made
pdf_not_ready.body: Try again in a moment. You can print from the print view meanwhile.

certificate_cancelled.title: This certificate was cancelled
certificate_cancelled.body: Its PDF is not handed out. Print it from the print view, where it is marked CANCELLED.

document_not_ready.title: The PDF is still being checked
document_not_ready.body: Every file is checked for viruses first. Try again in a moment.

not_printable.title: Nothing to print
not_printable.body: This request was closed without a certificate.

serial_number_conflict.title: The serial number was just taken
serial_number_conflict.body: Try again: the next free number will be used.

too_many_rows.title: This register is too long to print at once
too_many_rows.body: Choose one certificate type or a single academic year.

detail.waitingForYouBody: Open the print view to check the draft against the paper register, then approve or reject it. Approving a TC takes the student off the rolls.
detail.ownRequestBody: Someone else with approval rights must approve it. You can withdraw it while it waits.
detail.cancelledBody: It keeps its serial number and shows as cancelled in the register.
detail.cancelledBodyTc: It keeps its serial number and shows as cancelled in the register. The student was not re-admitted: do that separately if needed.
detail.printedBody: Frozen when it was issued. To correct a value, request a correction, cancel this certificate and issue a new one.
detail.requestedBody: The values from the student record are taken when it is approved.
detail.printBody: Print on the school's paper and have the principal sign and seal it. Reprints of the same certificate are fine; a lost certificate needs a duplicate.
detail.draftBody: A draft marked “not valid”, to check before approving.
detail.issuedActionsBody: Issue a marked duplicate for a lost certificate, or cancel one issued by mistake.
detail.approveBody: It gets the next serial number and a line in the register. A transfer certificate also takes the student off the rolls from the date of leaving.
detail.approveNoteHint: The person who prepared it will see this.
detail.rejectBody: Nothing is issued. Say what needs to change.
detail.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. Never type an Aadhaar number.
detail.withdrawBody: Nothing is issued and the principal no longer sees it.
detail.duplicateBody: A copy of what the original printed, marked “Duplicate” with the original serial number.
detail.duplicateBodyApproval: A copy of what the original printed, marked “Duplicate” with the original serial number. A TC duplicate waits for the principal's approval.
detail.cancelBody: It keeps its serial number and shows as cancelled in the register. This cannot be undone.
detail.cancelBodyTc: It keeps its serial number and shows as cancelled in the register. The student is not re-admitted automatically. This cannot be undone.
detail.pdfFailed: The PDF could not be made.
detail.pdfPreparing: The PDF is being made and checked. It is usually ready within a minute.

issue.title: Issue a certificate
issue.typeBody: Bonafide, study and conduct certificates are issued at once. A transfer certificate goes to the principal for approval.
issue.previewBody: From the student record, as it is now. Check it against the admission register.
issue.blockedBody: SchoolOS never changes a record by itself. Correct the value through a change request or resolve the finding, then check again.
issue.provisionalBody: These values are not verified against the admission register yet: {fields}. Check them on paper before issuing.
issue.inputsBody: When you issue it, it gets the next serial number and a line in the register.
issue.inputsBodyApproval: It is sent to the principal. It gets its serial number when approved.
issue.endsEnrolmentBody: When the principal approves this TC, the student's class enrolment ends on the date of leaving and the student is marked as left.
issue.blockedHint: Fix the problems above to continue.

blockers.dq_blocker: A data check found a blocking problem ({rule}) in {field}.
blockers.missing_value: {field} is empty in the admission register.
blockers.no_enrolment: The student is not in a class this academic year.
blockers.student_not_active: The student is not studying here now.
blockers.no_current_year: No academic year is marked as current.
blockers.transfer_certificate_exists: This student already has a transfer certificate.

registers.title: Registers
registers.description: Print the registers in their familiar A4 format, in English and Telugu, to keep the paper registers complete.
registers.noPermission: You can see certificates but not print the registers. Ask the principal if you need them.
registers.stepUpTitle: You may be asked to confirm it's you
registers.stepUpBody: Registers list many students' details, so SchoolOS asks for a fresh sign-in with your second step every few minutes.
registers.readyNote: Ready. Print it from the new tab (landscape, A4).

transfer.title: TC register (counterfoil)
transfer.body: Every transfer certificate of the year by serial number, with cancelled ones and duplicates.

certificates.title: Certificate issue register
certificates.body: Bonafide, study and conduct certificates issued in the year.

admission.title: Admission and withdrawal register
admission.body: Students enrolled in the year, in admission-number order, with their leaving details and TC number.

letterhead.title: Certificate letterhead
letterhead.description: Printed at the top of every certificate and at the signature. Leave a field empty to leave it out.
letterhead.nameEnNote: The English name is the school's name: {name}. SchoolOS sets it when the school is added.

hints.school_name_te: As it should appear on certificates.
hints.address_en: One line, for example the street, town and PIN code.
hints.affiliation: For example the recognition order number or the UDISE code.
hints.place: Printed next to the date, for example the town.

letterhead.logoNote: A school logo cannot be added yet.
letterhead.saved: Letterhead saved. New certificates use it.

circulars.title: Circulars
circulars.description: Circulars you can see, read with AI into a short summary and suggested deadlines. Nothing becomes a task until you confirm it.
circulars.noAccessBody: Ask your school's office admin if you need to see circulars.
circulars.emptyBody: Upload a circular as a document of type Circular; it is read with AI and appears here.

reason.ai_disabled: AI is switched off for your school.
reason.ai_budget_exhausted: This month's AI budget is used up.
reason.ai_rate_limited: Too many AI requests just now.
reason.ai_unavailable: The AI service was not available.
reason.ai_request_rejected: The AI service refused the request.
reason.ai_invalid_output: The AI answer could not be checked.
reason.no_text: The file has no readable text (for example a photo or scan).
reason.worker_error: Reading stopped because of an error.
reason.other: The circular could not be read.

circulars.aiNote: Read by AI from this circular only. Check it against the circular before you act.
circulars.notReadBody: This circular has not been read with AI yet. It is read when its file has been checked and indexed.
circulars.busyBody: This takes a few seconds. The page updates by itself.
circulars.needsReviewBody: Add its deadlines on the Tasks page, or try again later.
circulars.partial: This circular is long; only its first part was read. Check the rest yourself.
circulars.dropped: {count, plural, one {# suggestion was left out because its date or sentence is not in the circular.} other {# suggestions were left out because their date or sentence is not in the circular.}}
circulars.suggestionsDescription: Each one quotes the sentence it comes from. Confirm it as a task with an owner, or dismiss it.
circulars.noSuggestions: No deadlines were found in this circular. Read it and add tasks by hand if needed.

suggestion.dueInvalid: Enter a real date as {format}, for example {example}.

circulars.reviewPending: {count, plural, one {Decide # more suggestion first.} other {Decide # more suggestions first.}}
circulars.reviewReady: Every suggestion is decided. Mark the circular reviewed.
circulars.noticeDescription: Draft a short notice in English and Telugu from this circular. Only the circular's text is used, never student records.
circulars.noticePersonal: This circular is marked personal or restricted, so it can't be used for a parent notice.

reading_in_progress.title: Already being read
reading_in_progress.body: This circular is being read now. Wait a few seconds.

reading_done.title: Already read
reading_done.body: This version of the circular has been read. Upload a new version to read it again.

reading_attempts_used.title: Tried several times
reading_attempts_used.body: Reading failed several times. Read it yourself and add its tasks by hand.

document_not_ready.title: File still being checked
document_not_ready.body: The file is still being checked. Try again in a minute.

suggestion_decided.title: Already decided
suggestion_decided.body: Someone already confirmed or dismissed this suggestion. The page shows the latest.

suggestions_open.title: Suggestions left
suggestions_open.body: Confirm or dismiss every suggested deadline first.

version_mismatch.title: Changed meanwhile
version_mismatch.body: Someone else changed this. The page shows the latest; try again.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Work with an owner and a due date, from circulars or added by hand. You get a reminder before the due date and when it is late.
tasks.noAccessBody: Ask your school's office admin if you need tasks.
tasks.emptyBody: Tasks appear when someone confirms a circular's deadline or adds a task for you.

new.title: Add a task
new.description: For work that is not in a circular. The owner is told in the app.
new.dueInvalid: Enter a real date as {format}, for example {example}.

edit.title: Edit task
edit.description: Change the task, its owner, due date or details. A new owner is told in the app.
edit.dueInvalid: Enter a real date as {format}, for example {example}.

task_closed.title: Task is closed
task_closed.body: Done or cancelled tasks can't be changed. Reopen it first.

task_status_not_allowed.title: Not possible
task_status_not_allowed.body: This change of status is not possible. The page shows the latest.

task_cancel_not_allowed.title: Only the office can cancel
task_cancel_not_allowed.body: Ask the office admin or principal to cancel this task.

not_task_owner.title: Not your task
not_task_owner.body: Only the task's owner can change its status.

tasks_not_all.title: Only your tasks
tasks_not_all.body: You can see only the tasks given to you.

version_mismatch.title: Changed meanwhile
version_mismatch.body: Someone else changed this task. The page shows the latest; try again.

notices.title: Parent notices
notices.description: Short notices in English and Telugu for your parents' groups. Staff edit them and an approver approves them; SchoolOS never sends them itself.
notices.noAccessBody: Ask your school's office admin if you need to make parent notices.
notices.emptyBody: Start one below, or from a circular's page.
notices.aiDrafted: Drafted by AI from the circular only. Check every date and word before approving.

draftError.ai_disabled: AI is switched off for your school, so the notice starts empty.
draftError.ai_budget_exhausted: This month's AI budget is used up, so the notice starts empty.
draftError.no_text: The circular has no readable text, so the notice starts empty.

draftError.source_unavailable: The circular or text this notice was started from can no longer be used.
draftError.notice_source_personal: The circular is now marked personal or restricted, so AI can't use it.

new.title: Start a notice
new.description: Write what parents need to know; AI drafts it in English and Telugu. Or start empty.
new.privacyBody: Never write student names, phone numbers, Aadhaar numbers or email addresses in a parent notice.
new.textHint: For example: sports day on 14/11/2026 at 9:00, students wear house T-shirts.
new.personal: Remove phone numbers, email addresses and 12-digit numbers first.
new.fromCircularHint: To draft from a circular, open it on the Circulars page.

editor.title: Title
editor.noPersonal: Do not add names, phone numbers, Aadhaar numbers or email addresses.
editor.personal: Remove phone numbers, email addresses and 12-digit numbers.
editor.approverNeeded: The principal or owner approves notices.
editor.incomplete: Fill in both titles and both notices before approving.

approved.copied: Copied. Paste it into your parents' group.
approved.renderFailed: The PDF and image could not be made. Try again.
approved.postNote: SchoolOS does not send notices to parents. Post it in your existing groups yourself.

notice_personal_data.title: Personal details found
notice_personal_data.body: Remove phone numbers, email addresses and 12-digit numbers, then try again.

notice_source_personal.title: Circular can't be used
notice_source_personal.body: This circular is marked personal or restricted. Write the notice yourself.

notice_incomplete.title: Notice not complete
notice_incomplete.body: Fill in both titles and both notices before approving.

notice_approved.title: Already approved
notice_approved.body: An approved notice can't be changed. Start a new one.

notice_files_not_ready.title: Files not ready
notice_files_not_ready.body: The PDF and image are still being made. Try again shortly.

notice_files_expired.title: Files removed
notice_files_expired.body: The files are kept for a few days only. Make them again.

render_in_progress.title: Already being made
render_in_progress.body: The PDF and image are being made now.

version_mismatch.title: Changed meanwhile
version_mismatch.body: Someone else changed this notice. The page shows the latest; try again.

notice_drafting.title: Still drafting
notice_drafting.body: AI is still drafting this notice. Wait a moment, then try again.

notice_not_draft_failed.title: Nothing to try again
notice_not_draft_failed.body: AI is drafting this notice now or has already drafted it. The page shows the latest.

drafting.title: AI is drafting this notice in English and Telugu…
drafting.body: This usually takes under a minute. You can leave this page; the notice stays in the list.
drafting.slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can leave this page and open the notice later from the list.

draftFailed.title: AI could not draft this notice
draftFailed.body: Try again, or write the notice yourself below.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Mark a section's attendance for the day, see the month register or add a month from the register sheet.
attendance.noAccessBody: Ask your school's office admin if you need to mark or see attendance.
attendance.pickBody: Choose a section to mark or see its attendance.
attendance.emptyBody: Students appear here once they are placed in the section.
attendance.notMarkedYet: Attendance for this day is not marked yet. Everyone starts as present: change the students who are absent, late or on leave, then save.
attendance.saved: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing changed.} one {Saved # entry.} other {Saved # entries.}}
attendance.schoolDays: {count, plural, =0 {No school days marked this month.} one {# school day marked.} other {# school days marked.}}
attendance.legend: P present · A absent · L late · LV leave. Days with no mark are left empty.

import.title: Add a month from the register sheet
import.description: Upload the sheet (XLSX or CSV). We show what we read and any problems; nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.name: Name
import.summary: Read {entries, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} for {students, plural, one {# student} other {# students}} over {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.

marks.title: Marks
marks.description: Create exams, enter or import a section's marks and see the results.
marks.noAccessBody: Ask your school's office admin if you need to enter or see marks.
marks.pickTitle: Choose a section and an exam
marks.pickBody: Choose both to enter or see marks.
marks.emptyBody: Students appear here once they are placed in the section.

newExam.title: New exam
newExam.description: Exams belong to the current academic year. Give each one a name the teachers know, like “Formative assessment 1”.
newExam.name: Exam name

entry.title: Enter marks for one subject
entry.description: Type the marks for each student. Type AB for a student who was absent. Leave a box empty to skip that student.
entry.subject: Subject
entry.hint: Marks can have up to two decimals, for example 42.5.
entry.saved: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing changed.} one {Saved # mark.} other {Saved # marks.}}

problem.maxInvalid: Type the maximum marks as a number above 0 (at most 1000).
problem.marksInvalid: Some marks are not numbers between 0 and the maximum. Fix them or type AB for absent.
problem.nothingEntered: Type at least one student's marks.

import.title: Add marks from a sheet
import.description: Row 1: admission or roll number, then one column per subject. Row 2: the maximum marks. Then one row per student; AB means absent. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.summary: Read {entries, plural, one {# mark} other {# marks}} for {students, plural, one {# student} other {# students}} in {subjects, plural, one {# subject} other {# subjects}}.

insights.title: Students to follow up
insights.description: Flags from fixed rules on attendance, behaviour notes and marks. Each flag needs a person to act; nothing here is decided by AI.
insights.purpose: Use this only to support the student's learning and safety. Do not share it outside the school or use it for anything else.
insights.noAccessBody: Only the class teacher of the student's section and the principal can see follow-up flags.
insights.emptyBody: Flags appear when a rule notices a pattern, like three school days absent in a row.

why.attendance_streak: Absent {days} school days in a row ({from} to {to}). The rule is {threshold} or more.
why.attendance_rate: Attended {rate}% of the last {days} school days ({present} days). The rule is below {threshold}%.
why.course_low: Scored {percent}% overall in the latest exam. The rule is below {threshold}%.
why.course_decline: Overall result fell {drop} points, from {previous_percent}% to {percent}%. The rule is a fall of {threshold} or more.
why.behaviour_concerns: {concerns} concern notes in the last {window_days} days. The rule is {threshold} or more.

summary.onTimeHint: {count, plural, =0 {No flag acted on by its due date} one {# flag acted on by its due date} other {# flags acted on by their due date}}

rules.title: How flags are raised
rules.description: Rules run every day and after attendance or marks are saved. A new flag goes to the class teacher, who has {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to act.

explain.attendance_streak: Flags a student absent {threshold} or more school days in a row (the Andhra Pradesh follow-up).
explain.attendance_rate: Flags attendance below {threshold}% over the last {window} school days.
explain.course_low: Flags an overall result below {threshold}% in the latest exam.
explain.course_decline: Flags a fall of {threshold} or more points from the previous exam.
explain.behaviour_concerns: Flags {threshold} or more concern notes in {window} days.

rules.stepUp: Saving may ask you to confirm your sign-in again.
rules.saved: Rules saved. They apply from the next run.

detail.title: Follow-up flag
detail.description: Why this flag was raised, what has been done and what to do next.
detail.logDescription: Oldest first. Notes are seen only by people who can act on this flag.

log.someone: a rule or a former staff member

action.title: Log what you did
action.description: The first action marks the flag as in progress. Write only what helps the student; no Aadhaar numbers.
action.noteHint: Up to 1,000 characters. Kept encrypted and seen only by the class teacher and the principal.

close.title: Close this flag
close.description: Close it when the student is supported or the concern has passed. The log stays for a year, then it is deleted.

assign.title: Give this flag to someone else
assign.description: Only staff who can act for this student are listed. They are told in the app.
assign.nobody: Nobody else can act for this student.

erase.title: Erase this flag
erase.description: The flag and its log are deleted for good. The audit log keeps only that it was erased and why.

raise.title: Raise a follow-up flag
raise.description: For a concern the rules do not see. It goes to the class teacher, who has a week to act.

notes.title: Add a behaviour note
notes.description: Write what you saw, not a judgement. Notes are kept encrypted, seen only by the class teacher and the principal, and deleted after a year.
notes.textHint: Up to 500 characters. No Aadhaar numbers.
notes.eraseDescription: The note is deleted for good. The audit log keeps only that it was erased and why.

indicators.attendanceDays: {days, plural, one {# school day} other {# school days}} marked, {absent} absent
indicators.streakHint: Up to the last marked day

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: Newest first: flags, notes, exams, attendance by month and class placements.
timeline.emptyBody: Attendance, marks, notes and flags appear here as they are recorded.
timeline.notInScopeTitle: Only the class teacher and the principal can see this
timeline.notInScopeBody: The timeline is for the class teacher of the student's current section and the principal.
timeline.attendanceBody: {days} days marked: {present} present, {late} late, {absent} absent, {leave} on leave.
timeline.examBody: Overall {percent}% in {papers, plural, one {# paper} other {# papers}} ({absent} absent).

sheet.sampleTitle: What the sheet should look like
sheet.aadhaarWarning: Remove any Aadhaar numbers from the sheet first. Sheets with a full Aadhaar number are refused.
sheet.file: Sheet (XLSX or CSV, up to 2 MB)

fileProblem.fileType: Upload an XLSX or CSV file.
fileProblem.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB. Remove extra sheets or rows and try again.

upload.network: The upload stopped. Check your internet connection and try again.
upload.storage_rejected: The file could not be stored. Try again.
upload.scan_failed: The virus check failed. Try again later.
upload.quarantined: The file was blocked by the virus check. Use a clean copy.
upload.scan_timeout: The virus check is taking too long. Try again in a few minutes.

sheet.nothingToAdd: The sheet has nothing new to save.
sheet.fixFirst: Fix these problems in the sheet and upload it again. Nothing was saved.
sheet.saved: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing changed.} one {Saved # entry.} other {Saved # entries.}}
sheet.issuesTitle: {count, plural, one {# problem in the sheet} other {# problems in the sheet}}
sheet.issuesBody: The uploaded file has been deleted. Fix the cells below and upload the sheet again.

codes.aadhaar_full_number_rejected: A full Aadhaar number. Remove it.
codes.bad_code: Not an attendance code. Use P, A, L or LV.
codes.bad_date: Not a date. Use a date like 01/09/2026.
codes.bad_marks: Not a mark. Use a number or AB for absent.
codes.bad_max_marks: The maximum marks must be a number above 0 (at most 1000).
codes.date_out_of_range: This date is outside the academic year.
codes.formula_not_allowed: A formula. Type the value instead.
codes.future_date: This date is in the future.
codes.subject_too_long: The subject name is longer than 60 characters.
codes.unknown_student: Not a student of this section.

problems.not_in_section: Some students are not in this section. Reload the page and try again.
problems.future_date: A date is in the future. Choose today or an earlier date.
problems.date_out_of_range: A date is outside the current academic year.
problems.duplicate_entry: A student appears twice for the same day or subject.
problems.too_many_entries: Too many entries at once. Save a smaller part.
problems.aadhaar_full_number_rejected: Remove the Aadhaar number and try again.
problems.marks_over_max: Some marks are more than the maximum.
problems.absent_has_no_marks: A student marked absent cannot also have marks.
problems.exam_other_year: This exam belongs to another academic year.
problems.recorded_in_another_section: Some days or papers were recorded in the section the student was in before. Ask the principal to correct them.
problems.exam_name_taken: An exam with this name already exists this year. Choose another name.
problems.too_old: The date is too far back. Notes can go back 60 days.
problems.not_enrolled: The student is not in a section this year.
problems.before_flag: The action date is before the flag was raised.
problems.owner_not_eligible: That person cannot act for this student. Choose someone from the list.
problems.threshold_out_of_bounds: A threshold is outside the allowed range.
problems.rule_required: The absent-days-in-a-row rule cannot be switched off.
problems.student_column_missing: The first column must be the admission number or roll number.
problems.header_missing: The first row must have the column headings.
problems.too_many_dates: The sheet has more than 31 dates. Upload one month at a time.
problems.too_many_subjects: The sheet has too many subjects. Split it.
problems.too_many_rows: The sheet has too many rows.
problems.too_many_columns: The sheet has too many columns.
problems.max_row_missing: Row 2 must have the maximum marks for each subject.
problems.file_unreadable: The file could not be read. Save it again as XLSX or CSV.
problems.file_too_complex: The file is too complex to read. Copy the values into a new sheet.
problems.not_utf8: Save the CSV file as UTF-8 and try again.
problems.no_worksheet: The file has no sheet with data.
problems.other: Check the values and try again.

flag_closed.title: This flag is closed
flag_closed.body: Reload the page to see what changed. Raise a new flag if the concern is back.

flag_conflict.title: The flag could not be raised

no_current_year.title: No current academic year
no_current_year.body: Ask the office admin to set the current academic year in Settings, then try again.

off.title: The Tally connector is not switched on
off.body: SchoolOS support switches it on for your school when you are ready. Until then, fee dues are not shown here.

dues.title: Fee dues
dues.description: Dues from Tally for students whose ledgers are linked. Compare the figures with Tally before you act on them.
dues.noAccessBody: Ask the principal or accountant if you need fee figures.
dues.unlinkedHint: {amount} due on ledgers not linked to a student
dues.asOfHint: The date of the last sync from the office PC
dues.unlinkedTitle: Some ledgers are not linked to a student
dues.unlinkedBody: Their dues are not counted for any student. Link them so the totals match Tally.
dues.listDescription: Highest due first. Only students you can see are listed.
dues.emptyBody: No linked ledger has a due, or no sync has arrived yet.

connector.title: Tally connector
connector.description: A small program on the office PC reads fee ledgers from Tally and sends them to SchoolOS. It only reads; it never changes Tally.
connector.noAccessTitle: You cannot manage the Tally connector
connector.noAccessBody: The owner, principal or accountant can manage it.

status.title: Status
status.silentBody: The office PC has not sent Tally figures recently. Check that the PC is on, Tally is open and the SchoolOS Tally agent service is running.

devices.title: Office PC agents
devices.description: Each agent has its own key. Revoke an agent when the PC is replaced, lost or given to someone else.
devices.emptyBody: Add an agent, then run the command on the office PC where Tally is installed.
devices.revokeBody: The agent stops working at once. Figures already synced stay. To sync again, add a new agent.

enrol.title: Add an office PC agent
enrol.description: SchoolOS makes a one-time code. Whoever installs the agent on the office PC uses it once.
enrol.deviceNameHint: For example: Accounts PC. Do not use a person's name.
enrol.onceTitle: This code is shown only once
enrol.onceBody: It works once and expires at {time}. Do not send it by WhatsApp or email; read it out or type it on the office PC.
enrol.commandLabel: Command to run on the office PC
enrol.commandHint: Run it in a command window opened as administrator, after installing the SchoolOS Tally agent.
enrol.handedOver: I have used or written down the code

groups.title: Ledger groups to send
groups.description: The agent sends only the ledgers under the groups you choose here, such as Sundry Debtors or Students.
groups.emptyBody: The group list appears after the agent first connects with Tally open.
groups.privacyBody: Do not choose staff salary, supplier or bank groups. SchoolOS needs only students' fee ledgers.
groups.saved: {count, plural, =0 {Saved. No groups are selected.} one {Saved. 1 group is selected.} other {Saved. # groups are selected.}}

ledgers.title: Link ledgers to students
ledgers.description: A ledger's dues count for a student only after a person links them. SchoolOS suggests; it never links by itself.
ledgers.noAccessBody: The owner, principal or accountant can link Tally ledgers.
ledgers.emptyBody: Change the filter, or wait for the next sync from the office PC.
ledgers.unlinkBody: {ledger} will no longer count for {student}. Tally is not changed.

link.title: Link a ledger
link.personDecides: Check the admission number and class before you link. One ledger can be linked to brothers and sisters.
link.noCandidates: No close match by name. Search for the student below.
link.searchLabel: Search students by name or admission number
link.noResults: No student found. Check the spelling or the admission number.

too_many_devices.title: Too many agents
too_many_devices.body: Revoke an agent you no longer use, then add the new one.

already_revoked.title: Already revoked
already_revoked.body: Someone revoked this agent already. The list is now up to date.

party_gone.title: Ledger no longer in Tally
party_gone.body: This ledger was not in the last sync. Refresh the list and link a current ledger.

precondition_failed.title: The agent changed
precondition_failed.body: Someone changed this agent while you were looking. The list is now up to date; try again.
